title: CYBERNET V1 HITBOX EXPANDER OP// NEW version
features:
Hitbox Expander: Enlarges enemy head hitboxes.

    Global Hitbox: Enlarges the entire body of all enemies.

    Freeze Players: Freezes enemy movement (WalkSpeed & JumpPower = 0).

    Visual ESP (Highlight): Outlines enemies through walls (Red = visible, Green = behind wall).

    Health Bar: Displays a floating health bar above enemy heads.

    Cyber Tracers: Draws lines from your screen bottom to enemies.

    Team Check: Excludes teammates from all features.

    UI Features: Draggable menu, [RightShift] toggle key, and a mobile button.

It's still in progress and I'm working on it. Updates and more features are being posted on Scriptblox and Discord. If you want, join the Cybernet Discord server. I'm still working on it, so yeah. 

DISCORD: https://discord.gg/CXdqamrD6
